hooks.prompt: Analyze `git diff HEAD --stat` and `git diff HEAD` to understand what changed in this session. SURGICALLY update only the sections of ARCHITECT.md and README.md that reflect these changes. Do not rewrite the entire file. If nothing structural changed (only bug fixes or tests), do not touch ARCHITECT.md. Always update the 'Last updated' section with today's date.

Update the `.claudememory` file in the project root with the current session state: add to '## Recent Technical Decisions' the architectural or technical choices made today (with date YYYY-MM-DD), mark [x] resolved TODOs, add newly identified TODOs, update '## Features in Development' with the current branch and status. Do not delete history: add at the top of sections. Keep the file under 100 lines: archive decisions older than 30 days in an '## Archive' block at the bottom. If the file does not exist, create it with the standard structure.
